# 1 Samuel Chapter 23 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 164r–164v | **Source Image:** 1SA_023_page_001.jpg, 1SA_023_page_002.jpg

---

**1** And they told David, saying, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are plundering the threshing floors."
**2** And David inquired of the LORD, saying, "Shall I go and strike these Philistines?" And the LORD said to David, "Go and strike the Philistines and save Keilah."
**3** And David's men said to him, "Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the battle lines of the Philistines?"
**4** And David inquired of the LORD once more. And the LORD answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah, for I am giving the Philistines into your hand."
**5** And David and his men went to Keilah and fought against the Philistines. And he drove off their livestock and struck them with a great blow. And David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
**6** And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, that the ephod came down in his hand.
**7** And it was told to Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, "God has delivered him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town with gates and bars."
**8** And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
**9** And David knew that Saul was devising evil against him. And he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."
**10** And David said, "O LORD, God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city on my account.
**11** Will the lords of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, please tell your servant." And the LORD said, "He will come down."
**12** And David said, "Will the lords of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the LORD said, "They will surrender you."
**13** And David and his men arose — about six hundred men — and they went out from Keilah and wandered wherever they could go. And it was told to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, and he ceased going out.
**14** And David dwelt in the wilderness, in the strongholds, and he dwelt in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God did not give him into his hand.
**15** And David saw that Saul had come out to seek his soul. And David was in the wilderness of Ziph at Horesh.
**16** And Jonathan the son of Saul arose and went to David at Horesh, and he strengthened his hand in God.
**17** And he said to him, "Do not be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. And you shall reign over Israel, and I shall be second to you. And even Saul my father knows this."
**18** And the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. And David remained at Horesh, and Jonathan went to his house.
**19** And the Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah, which is south of Jeshimon?
**20** Now then, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down, and it shall be our part to surrender him into the hand of the king."
**21** And Saul said, "Blessed are you by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.
**22** Go now, make yet more sure. Know and see his place where his foot is — who has seen him there — for it has been told me that he is very cunning.
**23** See and learn of all the hiding places where he hides himself, and return to me with certain knowledge. Then I will go with you. And it shall be, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah."
**24** And they arose and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah to the south of Jeshimon.
**25** And Saul and his men went to seek him. And they told David, and he went down to the rock and dwelt in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
**26** And Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. And David was hurrying to get away from Saul, while Saul and his men were encircling David and his men to capture them.
**27** And a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid upon the land."
**28** So Saul turned back from pursuing David and went to meet the Philistines. Therefore they called that place the Rock of Division.
**29** And David went up from there and dwelt in the strongholds of En-gedi.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

All three translators agreed on the verse count (29 verses) and narrative structure for this chapter. SOPHIA follows the LOGOS formal-equivalence rendering as the baseline consensus, adopting PNEUMA's phrasing where it demonstrably improves clarity without sacrificing accuracy. Key terms and theological vocabulary were consistently rendered across all three translations.

---
## ⚠️ Disagreement Log

### Verse 1
- **EMET:** "And-they-told David, saying, "Behold, [the]-Philistines [are]-fighting against-Keilah and-they [are]-plundering the-threshing-floors.""
- **LOGOS:** "And they told David, saying, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are plundering the threshing floors.""
- **PNEUMA:** "David was told, "The Philistines are attacking Keilah and looting the threshing floors.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-inquired David of-YHWH, saying, "Shall-I-go and-strike against-these Philistines?" And-said YHWH to-David, "Go and-strike against-[the]-Philistine..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David inquired of the LORD, saying, "Shall I go and strike these Philistines?" And the LORD said to David, "Go and strike the Philistines and save..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David asked the LORD, "Should I go and fight these Philistines?" The LORD answered, "Go, attack the Philistines and rescue Keilah.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 3
- **EMET:** "And-said [the]-men of-David to-him, "Behold, we [are]-afraid here in-Judah, and-how-much-more if we-go to-Keilah against-[the]-battle-lines of-[the]-P..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David's men said to him, "Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the battle lines of the Philistines?""
- **PNEUMA:** "But David's men said to him, "We're already afraid here in Judah. How much worse if we go to Keilah and face the Philistine army!""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 4
- **EMET:** "And-again David inquired of-YHWH, and-YHWH answered-him and-said, "Arise, go-down to-Keilah, for I [am]-giving [the]-Philistines into-your-hand.""
- **LOGOS:** "And David inquired of the LORD once more. And the LORD answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah, for I am giving the Philistines into your han..."
- **PNEUMA:** "So David asked the LORD again, and the LORD answered, "Go down to Keilah. I am handing the Philistines over to you.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "And-it-was when-Abiathar son of-Ahimelech fled to-David to-Keilah, an-ephod came-down in-his-hand."
- **LOGOS:** "And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, that the ephod came down in his hand."
- **PNEUMA:** "When Abiathar son of Ahimelech had fled to David at Keilah, he brought the ephod with him."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-Saul summoned all the-people for-war, to-go-down to-Keilah, to-besiege David and-his-men."
- **LOGOS:** "And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul called up all his forces for war, to march down to Keilah and besiege David and his men."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-said David, "YHWH, God of-Israel, Your-servant has-surely-heard that Saul seeks to-come to-Keilah, to-destroy the-city on-my-account."
- **LOGOS:** "And David said, "O LORD, God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city on my account."
- **PNEUMA:** "Then David prayed, "LORD, God of Israel, your servant has heard that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town because of me."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 13
- **EMET:** "And-arose David and-his-men, about six-hundred men, and-went-out from-Keilah and-went-about wherever they-could-go. And-it-was-told to-Saul that David..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David and his men arose — about six hundred men — and they went out from Keilah and wandered wherever they could go. And it was told to Saul that ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "So David and his men — about six hundred of them — left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul heard that David had escaped from Keilah..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 14
- **EMET:** "And-dwelt David in-the-wilderness, in-the-strongholds, and-dwelt in-[the]-hill-country in-[the]-wilderness of-Ziph. And-sought-him Saul all the-days, ..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David dwelt in the wilderness, in the strongholds, and he dwelt in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David stayed in the wilderness strongholds, in the hill country of the Ziph wilderness. Saul searched for him every day, but God did not let him be fo..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 16
- **EMET:** "And-arose Jonathan son of-Saul and-went to-David to-Horesh, and-strengthened his-hand in-God."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jonathan the son of Saul arose and went to David at Horesh, and he strengthened his hand in God."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jonathan, Saul's son, went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 17
- **EMET:** "And-said to-him, "Do-not fear, for the-hand of-Saul my-father shall-not find-you, and-you shall-reign over Israel, and-I shall-be for-you [as]-second...."
- **LOGOS:** "And he said to him, "Do not be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. And you shall reign over Israel, and I shall be second to yo..."
- **PNEUMA:** ""Don't be afraid," Jonathan told him. "My father Saul will never lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be your second-in-command..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 20
- **EMET:** "And-now, according-to-all the-desire of-your-soul, O-king, come-down, come-down, and-ours [it will be] to-deliver-him into-[the]-hand of-the-king.""
- **LOGOS:** "Now then, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down, and it shall be our part to surrender him into the hand of the king..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Whenever you want to come down, O king, come — and we will hand him over to you ourselves.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 21
- **EMET:** "And-said Saul, "Blessed [are]-you to-YHWH, for you-have-had-compassion upon-me."
- **LOGOS:** "And Saul said, "Blessed are you by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul replied, "The LORD bless you for caring about me."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 22
- **EMET:** "Go, please, prepare further, and-know and-see his-place where his-foot [regel] is — who saw-him there — for it-has-been-told to-me [that] he-is-very c..."
- **LOGOS:** "Go now, make yet more sure. Know and see his place where his foot is — who has seen him there — for it has been told me that he is very cunning."
- **PNEUMA:** "Go and make sure. Find out exactly where he goes and who has seen him there, because I'm told he is very cunning."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 23
- **EMET:** "And-see and-know from-all the-hiding-places where he-hides, and-return to-me with-certainty [el nakohn], and-I-will-go with-you. And-it-will-be, if he..."
- **LOGOS:** "See and learn of all the hiding places where he hides himself, and return to me with certain knowledge. Then I will go with you. And it shall be, if h..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Find every hiding place he uses, and come back to me with reliable information. Then I'll go with you. If he's anywhere in the land, I'll track him do..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 25
- **EMET:** "And-went Saul and-his-men to-seek. And-they-told David, and-he-went-down to-the-rock and-dwelt in-[the]-wilderness of-Maon. And-heard Saul and-pursued..."
- **LOGOS:** "And Saul and his men went to seek him. And they told David, and he went down to the rock and dwelt in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard, he ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul and his men went to search for him. When David heard about it, he moved down to the rock formation and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Sau..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 27
- **EMET:** "And-a-messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and-come, for [the]-Philistines have-spread upon-the-land.""
- **LOGOS:** "And a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid upon the land.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Then a messenger came to Saul: "Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land!""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 28
- **EMET:** "And-returned Saul from-pursuing after-David and-went to-meet [the]-Philistines. Therefore they-called that place Sela-ha-Mahlekot [Rock of-Divisions]."
- **LOGOS:** "So Saul turned back from pursuing David and went to meet the Philistines. Therefore they called that place the Rock of Division."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to deal with the Philistines. That is why the place is called the Rock of Escape."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
